educational_goal: Practice asking for help, sharing and thanking a friend
beginning: Dino notices Milo nearby and offers to help him find a little star.
development: They look together, sing about helping and celebrate the discovery.
conclusion: The friends thank each other and wave to the audience.

segments.title: A friend needs help
segments.text: Dino saw his friend. Could they find the little star together?
segments.visible_action: Dino looks toward Milo, then smiles.

segments.title: Little Helping Hands
segments.direction: Original warm English children's song, gentle clear singing, no imitation of existing songs
segments.visible_action: Dino and Milo look for the star, sway together, clap and wave when they find it.

lines: Little helping hands, what can we do?
Look beside a friend; I will look with you.
Help a little, share a smile,
Side by side, we shine a while.
Thank you, friend, for helping me!
Kindness grows for all to see.

segments.title: A calm ending
segments.visible_action: Both characters rest calmly in the forest.
